messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for RAFA Club Gosport / Solent
messages.body:
Hi

The dates won’t be until 2027 - likely not 4 dates as I don’t have 4 left!

Would he still honour us with £250 as we’re a charity military club? The
other soloists are charging £200-250 as a local favour.

We are a small venue too, so it would be Sat evening 2 sets of 45mins,
usually 9-11pm. Non-members are welcome but £2pp temp membership. Drinks
are cheaper than most regular pubs.

Thanks

Tracey P
RAFA Ents Officer

Hi Tracey,

Thanks for coming back to me. As you're a military charity club, Jake's happy to do £250 cash a night if the committee books two nights with him. That's two 45 minute sets from 9 till 11, with his own PA and no deposit. Clubs like yours are where he goes down best, so he'd love to come down to you.

His Saturdays are filling up fast, so here are the ones still free in 2027 for the committee to pick two from:

Kind regards,
Natalie
